### Wars

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Wars")]

Main article: [List of wars: 1900–1944 §1930–1944](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_wars:_1900%E2%80%931944#1930%E2%80%931944 "List of wars: 1900–1944")

[![Image 6](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/88/Kamp-wrzes22-anim.gif/250px-Kamp-wrzes22-anim.gif?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Kamp-wrzes22-anim.gif)

At the outbreak of **[World War II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II "World War II")**, both Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union invaded [Poland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poland "Poland"); by October 1939, they had divided the occupied territory between them in accordance with the secret part of the [Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Molotov%E2%80%93Ribbentrop_Pact "Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact").

*   [Colombia–Peru War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colombia%E2%80%93Peru_War "Colombia–Peru War") (September 1, 1932 – May 24, 1933) – fought between the [Republic of Colombia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republic_of_Colombia "Republic of Colombia") and the [Republic of Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republic_of_Peru "Republic of Peru")
*   [Chaco War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaco_War "Chaco War") (June 15, 1932 – June 10, 1935) – fought between [Bolivia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bolivia "Bolivia") and [Paraguay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paraguay "Paraguay") over the disputed territory of [Gran Chaco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gran_Chaco "Gran Chaco"), resulting in a Paraguayan victory in 1935; an agreement dividing the territory was made in 1938, formally ending the conflict
*   [Saudi–Yemeni War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi%E2%80%93Yemeni_War_(1934) "Saudi–Yemeni War (1934)") (March 1934 – May 12, 1934) – fought between [Saudi Arabia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia "Saudi Arabia") and the [Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mutawakkilite_Kingdom_of_Yemen "Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen")
*   [Second Italo-Ethiopian War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_Italo-Ethiopian_War "Second Italo-Ethiopian War") (October 3, 1935 – February 19, 1937)
*   [Second Sino-Japanese War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_Sino-Japanese_War "Second Sino-Japanese War") (July 7, 1937 – September 9, 1945) – fought between the [Republic of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republic_of_China_(1912%E2%80%9349) "Republic of China (1912–49)") and the [Empire of Japan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Empire_of_Japan "Empire of Japan"). It was the largest Asian war of the 20th century,[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930s#cite_note-1) and made up more than 50% of the casualties in the [Pacific theater of World War II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pacific_War "Pacific War").
*   [World War II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II "World War II") (September 1, 1939 – September 2, 1945) – global war centered in Europe and the Pacific but involving the majority of the world's countries, including all of the major powers such as Germany, Russia, America, Italy, Japan, France and the United Kingdom.

### Internal conflicts

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Internal conflicts")]

*   [![Image 7](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1d/Golpe_de_Estado_de_1930_en_Argentina_%281%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail_unscaled)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Golpe_de_Estado_de_1930_en_Argentina_(1).jpg)

Soldiers mobilizing during the [1930 Argentine coup.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930_Argentine_coup_d'%C3%A9tat "1930 Argentine coup d'état")

[Chinese Civil War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_Civil_War "Chinese Civil War") (1927–1949) – The ruling [Kuomintang](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kuomintang "Kuomintang") and the rebel [Chinese Communist Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_Communist_Party "Chinese Communist Party") fought a civil war for control of China. The Communists consolidated territory in the early 1930s and proclaimed a short-lived [Chinese Soviet Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_Soviet_Republic "Chinese Soviet Republic") that collapsed upon Kuomintang attacks, forcing a mass retreat known as the [Long March](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_March "Long March"). The Kuomintang and Communists attempted to put away their differences after 1937 to fight the [Japanese invasion of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese_invasion_of_China "Japanese invasion of China"), but intermittent clashes continued through the remainder of the 1930s. Even with some clashes they all fought the Japanese.
*   [1936–1939 Arab revolt in Palestine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1936%E2%80%931939_Arab_revolt_in_Palestine "1936–1939 Arab revolt in Palestine").
*   [Spanish Civil War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_Civil_War "Spanish Civil War") (July 17, 1936 – April 1, 1939) – Germany and Italy backed the anti-communist [Falange](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falange_Espa%C3%B1ola_y_de_las_JONS "Falange Española y de las JONS") forces of [Francisco Franco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Francisco_Franco "Francisco Franco"). The [Soviet Union](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soviet_Union "Soviet Union") and international communist parties (see [Abraham Lincoln Brigade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abraham_Lincoln_Brigade "Abraham Lincoln Brigade")) backed the left-wing republican faction in the war. The war ended in April 1939 with Franco's nationalist forces defeating the republican forces. Franco became [Head of State of Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_heads_of_state_of_Spain "List of heads of state of Spain") and [President of Government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Prime_Ministers_of_Spain "List of Prime Ministers of Spain"), and the Republic of Spain gave way to the [Spanish State](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_State "Spanish State"), an [authoritarian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Authoritarian "Authoritarian")[dictatorship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dictatorship "Dictatorship").
*   The Argentine government of [Hipólito Yrigoyen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip%C3%B3lito_Yrigoyen "Hipólito Yrigoyen") is overthrown by forces loyal to General [José Féliz Uriburu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_F%C3%A9lix_Uriburu "José Félix Uriburu") in 1930, the [coup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930_Argentine_coup_d'%C3%A9tat "1930 Argentine coup d'état") marked the start of the [Infamous Decade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infamous_Decade "Infamous Decade").

### Major political changes

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Major political changes")]

#### Germany – Rise of Nazism

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: Germany – Rise of Nazism")]

[![Image 8](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a7/Bundesarchiv_Bild_102-14468%2C_Berlin%2C_NS-Boykott_gegen_j%C3%BCdische_Gesch%C3%A4fte.jpg/250px-Bundesarchiv_Bild_102-14468%2C_Berlin%2C_NS-Boykott_gegen_j%C3%BCdische_Gesch%C3%A4fte.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Bundesarchiv_Bild_102-14468,_Berlin,_NS-Boykott_gegen_j%C3%BCdische_Gesch%C3%A4fte.jpg)

[SA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sturmabteilung "Sturmabteilung") paramilitaries outside a Berlin store during the [Nazi boycott of Jewish businesses](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nazi_boycott_of_Jewish_businesses "Nazi boycott of Jewish businesses"), 1933

*   The [NSDAP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nazi_Party "Nazi Party") (Nazi Party) under [Adolf Hitler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adolf_Hitler "Adolf Hitler") wins the [German federal election, March 1933](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German_federal_election,_March_1933 "German federal election, March 1933"). Hitler becomes [Chancellor of Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Chancellors_of_Germany "List of Chancellors of Germany"). The [Night of the Long Knives](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Night_of_the_Long_Knives "Night of the Long Knives") purge results in at least 85 casualties. Following the 1934 death in office of [Paul von Hindenburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_von_Hindenburg "Paul von Hindenburg"), [President of Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_German_presidents_since_1919 "List of German presidents since 1919"), Hitler's cabinet passes a law proclaiming the presidency vacant and transferring the role and powers of the head of state to Hitler, hereafter known as _[Führer und Reichskanzler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/F%C3%BChrer "Führer")_ (leader and chancellor). The [Weimar Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weimar_Republic "Weimar Republic") effectively gives way to [Nazi Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nazi_Germany "Nazi Germany"), a [totalitarian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Totalitarianism "Totalitarianism")[autocratic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autocracy "Autocracy")[national socialist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nazism "Nazism")[dictatorship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dictatorship "Dictatorship") committed to repudiating the [Treaty of Versailles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Treaty_of_Versailles "Treaty of Versailles"), persecuting and removing [Jews](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jews "Jews") and other minorities from German society, expanding Germany's territory, and opposing the spread of [communism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Communism "Communism").
*   Hitler pulls Germany out of the League of Nations, but hosts the [1936 Summer Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1936_Summer_Olympics "1936 Summer Olympics") to show his new Reich to the world as well as the supposed superior athleticism of his [Aryan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aryan_race "Aryan race") troops/athletes.
*   [Neville Chamberlain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neville_Chamberlain "Neville Chamberlain"), [Prime Minister of the United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Prime_Ministers_of_the_United_Kingdom "List of Prime Ministers of the United Kingdom") (1937–1940), attempts the [appeasement](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Appeasement "Appeasement") of Hitler in hope of avoiding war by allowing the dictator to annex the [Sudetenland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudetenland "Sudetenland") (the German-speaking regions of [Czechoslovakia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Czechoslovakia "Czechoslovakia")) and later signing the [Munich Agreement](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Munich_Agreement "Munich Agreement") and promising constituents "[Peace for our time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peace_for_our_time "Peace for our time")". He is ousted in favor of [Winston Churchill](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winston_Churchill "Winston Churchill") in May 1940, following the German [invasion of Norway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operation_Weser%C3%BCbung "Operation Weserübung").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930s#cite_note-2)
*   The assassination of the German diplomat [Ernst vom Rath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ernst_vom_Rath "Ernst vom Rath") by a German-born Polish Jew triggers the _[Kristallnacht](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kristallnacht "Kristallnacht")_ ("Night of Broken Glass") which occurred between 9 and 10 November 1938, carried out by the [Hitler Youth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hitler_Youth "Hitler Youth"), the [Gestapo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gestapo "Gestapo"), and the [SS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schutzstaffel "Schutzstaffel"), during which much of the Jewish population living in Nazi Germany and Austria was attacked – 91 Jews were murdered, and between 25,000 and 30,000 more were arrested and sent to [Nazi concentration camps](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nazi_concentration_camps "Nazi concentration camps"). Some 267 synagogues were destroyed, and thousands of homes and businesses were ransacked. _Kristallnacht_ also served as the pretext for the wholesale confiscation of firearms from German Jews.[![Image 9](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f3/Bundesarchiv_Bild_183-H12943%2C_M%C3%BCnchener_Abkommen%2C_Hitler_und_Mussolini.jpg/250px-Bundesarchiv_Bild_183-H12943%2C_M%C3%BCnchener_Abkommen%2C_Hitler_und_Mussolini.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Bundesarchiv_Bild_183-H12943,_M%C3%BCnchener_Abkommen,_Hitler_und_Mussolini.jpg)

Cheering crowds greet [Adolf Hitler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adolf_Hitler "Adolf Hitler") and [Benito Mussolini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benito_Mussolini "Benito Mussolini") in Munich, 1938

*   Germany and Italy pursue territorial expansionist agendas. Germany demands the annexation of the [Federal State of Austria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_State_of_Austria "Federal State of Austria") and of other German-speaking territories in Europe. Between 1935 and 1936, Germany recovers the [Saar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saar_(League_of_Nations) "Saar (League of Nations)") and re-militarizes the [Rhineland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhineland "Rhineland"). Italy initially opposes Germany's aims for Austria, but in 1936 the two countries resolve their differences in the aftermath of Italy's diplomatic isolation following the start of the [Second Italo-Abyssinian War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_Italo-Abyssinian_War "Second Italo-Abyssinian War"), and Germany becomes Italy's only remaining ally. Germany and Italy improve relations by forming an alliance against communism in 1936 with the signing of the [Anti-Comintern Pact](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anti-Comintern_Pact "Anti-Comintern Pact"). Germany annexes Austria in the [Anschluss](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anschluss "Anschluss"); the annexation of the [Sudetenland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudetenland "Sudetenland") follows negotiations which result in the [Munich Agreement](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Munich_Agreement "Munich Agreement") of 1938. The [Italian invasion of Albania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_invasion_of_Albania "Italian invasion of Albania") in 1939 succeeds in turning the [Kingdom of Albania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albania_under_Italy "Albania under Italy") into an Italian [protectorate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protectorate "Protectorate"). The vacant Albanian throne is claimed by [Victor Emmanuel III of Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Victor_Emmanuel_III_of_Italy "Victor Emmanuel III of Italy").[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930s#cite_note-isbn0-8240-7029-1-3) Germany receives the [Memel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Klaip%C4%97da_Region "Klaipėda Region") territory from [Lithuania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lithuania "Lithuania"), occupies what remains of [Czechoslovakia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Czechoslovakia "Czechoslovakia"), and finally invades the [Second Polish Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_Polish_Republic "Second Polish Republic"), the last of these events resulting in the outbreak of [World War II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II "World War II").
*   In 1939, several countries of the Americas, including Canada, [Cuba](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuba "Cuba"), and the United States, controversially deny asylum to hundreds of German Jewish refugees on board the [MS _St. Louis_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MS_St._Louis "MS St. Louis") who are fleeing the Nazi regime's racist agenda of [anti-Semitic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anti-Semitic "Anti-Semitic") persecution in Germany. In the end, certain European countries accept the refugees, and the ship returns to Germany with no passengers on board.

#### United States – Combating the Depression

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: United States – Combating the Depression")]

[![Image 10](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f6/Roosevelt_signing_TVA_Act_%281933%29.jpg/250px-Roosevelt_signing_TVA_Act_%281933%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Roosevelt_signing_TVA_Act_(1933).jpg)

[New Deal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Deal "New Deal"): President Franklin D. Roosevelt signs the [Tennessee Valley Authority](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tennessee_Valley_Authority "Tennessee Valley Authority") Act, May 18, 1933

*   [Franklin D. Roosevelt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franklin_D._Roosevelt "Franklin D. Roosevelt") is elected President of the United States in November 1932. Roosevelt initiates a widespread social welfare strategy called the "[New Deal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Deal "New Deal")" to combat the economic and social devastation of the [Great Depression](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Depression "Great Depression"). The economic agenda of the "New Deal" was a radical departure from previous [laissez-faire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laissez-faire "Laissez-faire") economics.

#### Saudi Arabia – Founding

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Saudi Arabia – Founding")]

*   The [Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_of_Hejaz_and_Nejd "Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd") is proclaimed the Kingdom of [Saudi Arabia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia "Saudi Arabia"), concluding the country's [unification](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unification_of_Saudi_Arabia "Unification of Saudi Arabia") under the rule of [Ibn Saud](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Saud_of_Saudi_Arabia "Ibn Saud of Saudi Arabia").

#### Spain – Turmoil and Civil War

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section: Spain – Turmoil and Civil War")]

*   The Republican parties win the [local elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_local_elections,_1931 "Spanish local elections, 1931"), and proclaim the [Second Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_Spanish_Republic "Second Spanish Republic"), kicking out the monarchy of [Alfonso XIII of Borbón](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfonso_XIII_of_Spain "Alfonso XIII of Spain").
*   The [Spanish coup of July 1936](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_coup_of_July_1936 "Spanish coup of July 1936") against the Republic marks the beginning of the [Spanish Civil War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_Civil_War "Spanish Civil War").

### Colonization

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: Colonization")]

*   The [Ethiopian Empire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ethiopian_Empire "Ethiopian Empire") is invaded by the [Kingdom of Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_of_Italy "Kingdom of Italy") during the [Second Italo-Abyssinian War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_Italo-Abyssinian_War "Second Italo-Abyssinian War") from 1935 to 1936. The occupied territory merges with [Eritrea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eritrea "Eritrea") and [Italian Somaliland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_Somaliland "Italian Somaliland") into the colony of [Italian East Africa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_East_Africa "Italian East Africa").
*   The [Empire of Japan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Empire_of_Japan "Empire of Japan") captures [Manchuria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manchuria "Manchuria") in 1931, creating the [puppet state](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Puppet_state "Puppet state") of [Manchukuo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manchukuo "Manchukuo"). A puppet government was created, with [Puyi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Puyi "Puyi"), the last [Qing dynasty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qing_dynasty "Qing dynasty")[Emperor of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emperor_of_China "Emperor of China"), installed as the nominal regent and emperor.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930s#cite_note-4)

### Decolonization and independence

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=10 "Edit section: Decolonization and independence")]

*   In March 1930 [Mohandas Gandhi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohandas_Gandhi "Mohandas Gandhi") leads the non-violent [Satyagraha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satyagraha "Satyagraha") movement in the [Declaration of the Independence of India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Declaration_of_the_Independence_of_India "Declaration of the Independence of India") and the [Salt March](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salt_Satyagraha "Salt Satyagraha").
*   The [Government of India Act 1935](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_India_Act_1935 "Government of India Act 1935") creates new directly elected bodies, although with a limited franchise, and increases the autonomy of the [Presidencies and provinces of British India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Presidencies_and_provinces_of_British_India "Presidencies and provinces of British India").
*   The [Anglo-Egyptian treaty of 1936](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anglo-Egyptian_treaty_of_1936 "Anglo-Egyptian treaty of 1936") is signed which gradually decreased British influence in Egypt and increased Egyptian sovereignty. It led to the withdrawal of British troops across Egypt to the Suez Canal Zone and decreased the number of British troops in the country to 10,000 men.

### Other prominent political events

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=11 "Edit section: Other prominent political events")]

*   The [Great Depression](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Depression "Great Depression") seriously affects the economic, political, and social aspects of society across the world.
*   The [League of Nations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/League_of_Nations "League of Nations") collapses as countries like Germany, the [Kingdom of Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_of_Italy "Kingdom of Italy"), and the [Empire of Japan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Empire_of_Japan "Empire of Japan") abdicate the League.

#### Europe

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=12 "Edit section: Europe")]

[![Image 11](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/27/HolodomorKharkiv_1933_Wienerberger.jpg/250px-HolodomorKharkiv_1933_Wienerberger.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:GolodomorKharkiv.jpg)

[Soviet famine of 1930–1933](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soviet_famine_of_1930%E2%80%931933 "Soviet famine of 1930–1933"). Starved peasants in the streets of Kharkiv, 1933

*   In 1930, [Miguel Primo de Rivera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miguel_Primo_de_Rivera "Miguel Primo de Rivera"), [Prime Minister of Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Spain "Prime Minister of Spain") and head of a [military dictatorship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Military_dictatorship "Military dictatorship") is forced to resign in response to a financial crisis (part of the [Great Depression](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Depression "Great Depression")). [Alfonso XIII of Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfonso_XIII_of_Spain "Alfonso XIII of Spain"), who had previously backed the dictatorship, attempts to return gradually to the previous system and restore his prestige. This failed utterly, as the King was considered a supporter of the dictatorship, and more and more political forces called for the establishment of a republic. In 1931, republican and socialist parties won a major victory in the local elections, while the monarchists were in decline. Street riots ensued, calling for the removal of the monarchy. The [Spanish Army](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_Army "Spanish Army") declared that they would not defend the King. Alfonso flees the country, effectively abdicating and ending the [Bourbon Restoration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spain_under_the_Restoration "Spain under the Restoration") phase which had started in the 1870s. A [Second Spanish Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_Spanish_Republic "Second Spanish Republic") emerges.
*   In the [Soviet Union](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soviet_Union "Soviet Union"), [agricultural collectivization](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Collectivization_in_the_Soviet_Union "Collectivization in the Soviet Union") and rapid [industrialization take place](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_the_Soviet_Union_(1927%E2%80%931953) "History of the Soviet Union (1927–1953)").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930s#cite_note-5) Millions died during the [Holodomor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Holodomor "Holodomor").
*   More than 25 million people migrate to cities in the Soviet Union.
*   [Anglo-German Naval Agreement](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anglo-German_Naval_Agreement "Anglo-German Naval Agreement") is signed in 1935, removing the [Treaty of Versailles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Treaty_of_Versailles "Treaty of Versailles")' level of limitation on the size of the _[Kriegsmarine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kriegsmarine "Kriegsmarine")_ (navy). The agreement allows Germany to build a larger naval force.
*   [Éamon de Valera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89amon_de_Valera "Éamon de Valera") introduces a new [constitution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitution "Constitution") for the [Irish Free State](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Irish_Free_State "Irish Free State") in 1937, effectively ending its status as a [British Dominion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dominion "Dominion").
*   The [Silver Jubilee of George V](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silver_Jubilee_of_George_V "Silver Jubilee of George V") was celebrated on 6 May 1935 to mark 25 years of [King George V](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_George_V "King George V") as the King of the [United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom "United Kingdom") and the British Dominions, and [Emperor of India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emperor_of_India "Emperor of India"). It was the first ever Silver Jubilee celebration of any British monarch in history.
*   The "[Great Purge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Purge "Great Purge")" of "[Old Bolsheviks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Old_Bolsheviks "Old Bolsheviks")" from the [Communist Party of the Soviet Union](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Communist_Party_of_the_Soviet_Union "Communist Party of the Soviet Union") takes place from 1936 to 1938, as ordered by Soviet Union leader [Joseph Stalin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joseph_Stalin "Joseph Stalin"), resulting in hundreds of thousands of people being killed. This purge was due to mistrust and political differences, as well as the massive drop in grain produce. This was due to the method of collectivization in Russia. The Soviet Union produced 16 million lbs of grain less in 1934 compared to 1930. This led to the starvation of millions of Russians.
*   The [Abdication of Edward VIII](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abdication_of_Edward_VIII "Abdication of Edward VIII") in 1936, gives the British Crown to [George VI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_VI "George VI"), 325 days after the death of his father [George V](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_V "George V"). The [Coronation of George VI and Elizabeth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coronation_of_George_VI_and_Elizabeth "Coronation of George VI and Elizabeth") takes place in May 1937.
*   The [1937 World's Fair](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exposition_Internationale_des_Arts_et_Techniques_dans_la_Vie_Moderne_(1937) "Exposition Internationale des Arts et Techniques dans la Vie Moderne (1937)") in Paris displays the growing political tensions in Europe. The pavilions of the rival countries of [Nazi Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nazi_Germany "Nazi Germany") and the Soviet Union face each other. Germany at the time was internationally condemned for [Luftwaffe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luftwaffe "Luftwaffe") (its air force) having performed a [bombing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bombing_of_Guernica "Bombing of Guernica") of the [Basque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basque_Country_(greater_region) "Basque Country (greater region)") town of [Guernica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guernica_(town) "Guernica (town)") in Spain during the [Spanish Civil War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_Civil_War "Spanish Civil War"). Spanish artist [Pablo Picasso](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pablo_Picasso "Pablo Picasso") depicted the bombing in his masterpiece painting _[Guernica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guernica\_(painting) "Guernica (painting)")_ at the World Fair, which was a [surrealist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surrealism "Surrealism") depiction of the horror of the bombing.
*   Referendum in the [Irish Free State](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Irish_Free_State "Irish Free State") in December 1937 on whether Ireland should continue to be a constitutional monarchy under King [George VI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_VI "George VI") or to become a [republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republic "Republic") results in citizens voting in favour of a republic, ending the remains of British sovereignty through monarchial authority over the state.

#### Americas

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=14 "Edit section: Americas")]

*   Canada and other dominions under the [British Empire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_Empire "British Empire") sign the [Statute of Westminster](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Statute_of_Westminster_1931 "Statute of Westminster 1931") in 1931, establishing effective parliamentary independence of Canada from the parliament of the United Kingdom.
*   [1939 New York World's Fair](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1939_New_York_World's_Fair "1939 New York World's Fair"), the USA displays the pavilions showing art, culture, and technology from the whole world.
*   [Newfoundland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newfoundland_and_Labrador "Newfoundland and Labrador") voluntarily returns to British colonial rule in 1934 amid its economic crisis during the Great Depression with the creation of the [Commission of Government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commission_of_Government "Commission of Government"), a non-elected body.
*   [Canadian Prime Minister](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Canada "Prime Minister of Canada")[W. L. Mackenzie King](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Lyon_Mackenzie_King "William Lyon Mackenzie King") meets with German [Führer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/F%C3%BChrer "Führer")[Adolf Hitler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adolf_Hitler "Adolf Hitler") in 1937 in Berlin. King is the only North American head of government to meet with Hitler.
*   [Amelia Earhart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amelia_Earhart "Amelia Earhart") receives major attention in the 1930s as the first woman pilot to conduct major air flights. Her disappearance for unknown reasons in 1937 while on flight prompted search efforts that failed.
*   Southern [Great Plains](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Plains "Great Plains") devastated by decades-long [Dust Bowl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dust_Bowl "Dust Bowl")
*   In 1932, the Polish [Cipher Bureau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cipher_Bureau_(Poland) "Cipher Bureau (Poland)") broke the German Enigma cipher and overcame the ever-growing structural and operating complexities of the evolving [Enigma machine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enigma_machine "Enigma machine") with [plugboard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plugboard "Plugboard"), the main German cipher device during [World War II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II "World War II").
*   [Getúlio Vargas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Get%C3%BAlio_Vargas "Getúlio Vargas") became the President of Brazil after the [1930 coup d'état](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revolution_of_1930 "Revolution of 1930").

#### Asia

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=15 "Edit section: Asia")]

[![Image 13](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/7c/Marche_sel.jpg/250px-Marche_sel.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Marche_sel.jpg)

[Mohandas Gandhi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohandas_Gandhi "Mohandas Gandhi") on the [Salt March](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salt_Satyagraha "Salt Satyagraha") in 1930

*   Major international media attention follows [Mohandas Gandhi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohandas_Gandhi "Mohandas Gandhi")'s [peaceful resistance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nonviolent_resistance "Nonviolent resistance") movement against the British colonial rule in India.
*   [Chinese Communist Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_Communist_Party "Chinese Communist Party") leader [Mao Zedong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mao_Zedong "Mao Zedong") forms the small enclave state called the [Chinese Soviet Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_Soviet_Republic "Chinese Soviet Republic") in 1931.
*   The [Gandhi–Irwin Pact](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gandhi%E2%80%93Irwin_Pact "Gandhi–Irwin Pact") is signed by Mohandas Gandhi and [Lord Irwin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E._F._L._Wood,_1st_Earl_of_Halifax "E. F. L. Wood, 1st Earl of Halifax"), [Viceroy of India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viceroy_of_India "Viceroy of India"), on March 5, 1931. Gandhi agrees to end the campaign of [civil disobedience](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Civil_disobedience "Civil disobedience") being carried out by the [Indian National Congress](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_National_Congress "Indian National Congress") (INC) in exchange for Irwin accepting the INC to participate in roundtable talks on British colonial policy in India.
*   The [Government of India Act of 1935](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_India_Act_1935 "Government of India Act 1935") is enacted by the [Governor-General of India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor-General_of_India "Governor-General of India"), separating [British Burma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_rule_in_Burma "British rule in Burma") to become a separate British possession and also increasing the political autonomy of the remaining [presidencies and provinces of British India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Presidencies_and_provinces_of_British_India "Presidencies and provinces of British India").
*   Mao Zedong's Chinese communists begin a large retreat from advancing nationalist forces, called the [Long March](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_March "Long March"), beginning in October 1934 and ending in October 1936 and resulting in the collapse of the Chinese Soviet Republic.[![Image 14](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/56/First_pictures_of_the_Japanese_occupation_of_Peiping_in_China.jpg/250px-First_pictures_of_the_Japanese_occupation_of_Peiping_in_China.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:First_pictures_of_the_Japanese_occupation_of_Peiping_in_China.jpg)

Japanese march into [Zhengyangmen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zhengyangmen "Zhengyangmen") of [Beijing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beijing "Beijing") after capturing the city in July 1937

*   Colonial India's [Muslim League](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/All-India_Muslim_League "All-India Muslim League") leader [Muhammed Ali Jinnah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammed_Ali_Jinnah "Muhammed Ali Jinnah") delivers his "[Day of Deliverance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Day_of_Deliverance_(India) "Day of Deliverance (India)")" speech on December 2, 1939, calling upon [Muslims](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muslims "Muslims") to begin to engage in civil disobedience against the British colonial government starting on December 12. Jinnah demands redress and resolution to tensions and violence occurring between Muslims and [Hindus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindus "Hindus") in India. Jinnah's actions are not supported by the largely Hindu-dominated [Indian National Congress](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_National_Congress "Indian National Congress") whom he had previously closely allied with. The decision is seen as part of an agenda by Jinnah to support the eventual creation of an independent Muslim state called [Pakistan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pakistan "Pakistan") from British Empire.

#### Australia

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=16 "Edit section: Australia")]

*   Australia and New Zealand sign the [Statute of Westminster](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Statute_of_Westminster_1931 "Statute of Westminster 1931") in 1931 which established legislative equality between the self-governing [dominions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dominion "Dominion") of the [British Empire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_Empire "British Empire") and the United Kingdom, with a few residual exceptions. *   The [New Guinea Highlands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Guinea_Highlands "New Guinea Highlands") were first visited by Western explorers in the 1930s. The highland valleys were found to be inhabited by over a million people.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930s#cite_note-6)

The German [dirigible](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dirigible "Dirigible")[airship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Airship "Airship")_[Hindenburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LZ\_129\_Hindenburg "LZ 129 Hindenburg")_ exploding in 1937

[![Image 16](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d2/Dust_storm_approaching_Stratford%2C_Texas.jpg/250px-Dust_storm_approaching_Stratford%2C_Texas.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Dust_storm_approaching_Stratford,_Texas.jpg)

A dust storm approaches [Stratford, Texas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stratford,_Texas "Stratford, Texas"), in 1935, during the [Dust Bowl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dust_Bowl "Dust Bowl")

*   The [China floods of 1931](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1931_China_floods "1931 China floods") are among the deadliest natural disasters ever recorded.
*   The [1935 Labor Day Hurricane](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1935_Labor_Day_Hurricane "1935 Labor Day Hurricane") makes landfall in the [Florida Keys](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Florida_Keys "Florida Keys") as a Category 5 hurricane and the most intense hurricane to ever make landfall in the Atlantic basin. It caused an estimated $6 million (1935 USD) in damages and killed around 408 people. The hurricane's strong winds and storm surge destroyed nearly all of the structures between [Tavernier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tavernier,_Florida "Tavernier, Florida") and [Marathon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marathon,_Florida "Marathon, Florida"), and the town of [Islamorada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamorada "Islamorada") was obliterated.
*   The German [dirigible](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dirigible "Dirigible")[airship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Airship "Airship")_[Hindenburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LZ\_129\_Hindenburg "LZ 129 Hindenburg")_ explodes in the sky above [Lakehurst, New Jersey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lakehurst,_New_Jersey "Lakehurst, New Jersey"), United States on May 6, 1937, killing 36 people. The event leads to an investigation of the explosion and the disaster causes major public distrust of the use of [hydrogen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrogen "Hydrogen")-inflated airships and seriously damages the reputation of the [Zeppelin company](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luftschiffbau_Zeppelin "Luftschiffbau Zeppelin").
*   The [New London School](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_London_School_explosion "New London School explosion") in [New London, Texas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_London,_Texas "New London, Texas"), is destroyed by an explosion, killing in excess of 300 students and teachers (1937).
*   The [New England Hurricane of 1938](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_England_Hurricane_of_1938 "New England Hurricane of 1938"), which became a Category 5 hurricane before making landfall as a Category 3. The hurricane was estimated to have caused property losses of US$306 million ($4.72 billion in 2010), killed between 682 and 800 people, and damaged or destroyed over 57,000 homes, including the home of famed actress [Katharine Hepburn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katharine_Hepburn "Katharine Hepburn"), who had been staying in her family's [Old Saybrook, Connecticut](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Old_Saybrook,_Connecticut "Old Saybrook, Connecticut"), beach home when the hurricane struck.
*   The [Dust Bowl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dust_Bowl "Dust Bowl"), or "Dirty Thirties", a period of severe [dust storms](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dust_storms "Dust storms") causing major ecological and agricultural damage to American and Canadian [prairie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prairie "Prairie") lands from 1930 to 1936 (in some areas until 1940). Caused by extreme [drought](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drought "Drought") coupled with strong winds and decades of extensive farming without [crop rotation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crop_rotation "Crop rotation"), fallow fields, [cover crops](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cover_crop "Cover crop"), or other techniques to prevent erosion, it affected an estimated 100,000,000 acres (400,000 km 2) of land (traveling as far east as New York and the Atlantic Ocean), caused mass migration (which was the inspiration for the [Pulitzer Prize](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pulitzer_Prize "Pulitzer Prize")-winning novel _[The Grapes of Wrath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Grapes\_of\_Wrath "The Grapes of Wrath")_ by [John Steinbeck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Steinbeck "John Steinbeck")), food shortages, multiple deaths and illness from sand inhalation, and a severe reduction in the going wage rate.
*   The [1938 Yellow River flood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1938_Yellow_River_flood "1938 Yellow River flood") pours out from [Huayuankou](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Huayuankou,_Henan "Huayuankou, Henan"), China, inundating 54,000 km 2 (21,000 sq mi) of land and killing an estimated 500,000 people.

Roosevelt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franklin_D._Roosevelt "Franklin D. Roosevelt"). *   [Engelbert Dollfuss](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engelbert_Dollfuss "Engelbert Dollfuss"), [Chancellor of Austria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chancellor_of_Austria "Chancellor of Austria") and leading figure of [Austrofascism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Austrofascism "Austrofascism"), is assassinated in 1934 by Austrian Nazis. Germany and Italy nearly clash over the issue of Austrian independence despite close ideological similarities of the [Italian Fascist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_Fascist "Italian Fascist") and Nazi regimes.
*   [Alexander I of Yugoslavia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_I_of_Yugoslavia "Alexander I of Yugoslavia") is assassinated in 1934 during a visit to [Marseille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marseille "Marseille"), France. The IMRO was a political organization that fought for secession of [Vardar Macedonia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vardar_Macedonia "Vardar Macedonia") from Yugoslavia.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930s#cite_note-7)

*   [Saitō Makoto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sait%C5%8D_Makoto "Saitō Makoto") and [Takahashi Korekiyo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Takahashi_Korekiyo "Takahashi Korekiyo"), both former prime ministers of Japan, are assassinated by ultranationalistic Army officers during the [February 26 incident](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_26_incident "February 26 incident") in 1936.
*   [Adolf Hitler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adolf_Hitler "Adolf Hitler"), dictator of [Nazi Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nazi_Germany "Nazi Germany"), survived an assassination attempt in 1939 when a bomb planted by [Georg Elser](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Georg_Elser "Georg Elser") exploded at the [Bürgerbräukeller](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%BCrgerbr%C3%A4ukeller "Bürgerbräukeller") in [Munich](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Munich "Munich"); he had left the building early, avoiding the blast that killed eight others.

## Economics

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1930s&action=edit&section=19 "Edit section: Economics")]

[![Image 18](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/da/UnemployedMenHopTrain.jpg/250px-UnemployedMenHopTrain.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:UnemployedMenHopTrain.jpg)

In the United States the significantly high unemployment rate lead many unemployed people to use freight trains in order to seek employment in various cities across the country

*   The [Great Depression](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Depression "Great Depression") is considered to have begun with the fall of stock prices on September 4, 1929, and then the [stock market crash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stock_market_crash "Stock market crash") known as [Black Tuesday](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wall_Street_crash_of_1929 "Wall Street crash of 1929") on October 29, 1929, and lasted through much of the 1930s.
*   The entire decade is marked by widespread unemployment and poverty, although deflation (i.e. falling prices) was limited to 1930–32 and 1938–39. Prices fell 7.02% in 1930, 10.06% in 1931, 9.79% in 1932, 1.41% in 1938 and 0.71% in 1939.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930s#cite_note-8)
*   [Economic interventionist policies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economic_interventionism "Economic interventionism") increase in popularity as a result of the Great Depression in both authoritarian and democratic countries. In the Western world, [Keynesianism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keynesianism "Keynesianism") replaces [classical economic theory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Classical_economics "Classical economics").
*   In an effort to reduce unemployment, the United States government created work projects such as the [Civilian Conservation Corps](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Civilian_Conservation_Corps "Civilian Conservation Corps") (CCC) which was a public work relief program that operated from 1933 to 1942 to maintain National Parks and build roads. Other major U.S. government work projects included [Hoover Dam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hoover_Dam "Hoover Dam") which was constructed between 1931 and 1936.
*   Rapid industrialization takes place in the [Soviet Union](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soviet_Union "Soviet Union").
*   [Prohibition in the United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prohibition_in_the_United_States "Prohibition in the United States") ended in 1933. On December 5, 1933, the ratification of the [Twenty-first Amendment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twenty-first_Amendment_to_the_United_States_Constitution "Twenty-first Amendment to the United States Constitution") repealed the [Eighteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eighteenth_Amendment_to_the_United_States_Constitution "Eighteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution").
*   Drought conditions in Oklahoma and Texas caused the [Dust Bowl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dust_Bowl "Dust Bowl") which forced tens of thousands of families to abandon their farms and seek employment elsewhere.

*   In 1930, [Warner Brothers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Warner_Brothers "Warner Brothers") released the first All-Talking All-Color wide-screen movie, _[Song of the Flame](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Song\_of\_the\_Flame\_(film) "Song of the Flame (film)")_; in 1930 alone, Warner Brothers released ten All-Color All-Talking feature movies in [Technicolor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technicolor "Technicolor") and scores of shorts and features with color sequences;

The Place de Varsovie in [Paris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris "Paris") during the [World Expo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exposition_Internationale_des_Arts_et_Techniques_dans_la_Vie_Moderne "Exposition Internationale des Arts et Techniques dans la Vie Moderne") in 1937, photographed using newly invented [Agfacolor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agfacolor "Agfacolor") process.

*   In 1931, [RCA Victor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RCA_Victor "RCA Victor") introduced the first long-playing phonograph record.
*   In 1935, the British [London and North Eastern Railway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/London_and_North_Eastern_Railway "London and North Eastern Railway") introduced the [A4 Pacific](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A4_Pacific "A4 Pacific"), designed by [Nigel Gresley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nigel_Gresley "Nigel Gresley"). **Lester Townes** "**Bob**" **Hope** ([né](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birth_name#Maiden_and_married_names "Birth name")**Leslie Townes Hope**; May 29, 1903 – July 27, 2003) was a British-born American comedian, actor, musician, entertainer and producer with a career that spanned nearly 80 years and achievements in [vaudeville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vaudeville "Vaudeville"), network radio, television, and [USO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USO "USO") Tours. He appeared in [more than 70 short and feature films](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope_filmography "Bob Hope filmography"), starring in 54, including a series of seven _[Road to ...](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Road\_to\_... "Road to ...")_ musical comedy films with [Bing Crosby](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bing_Crosby "Bing Crosby") as his partner. He reached his 100th birthday 59 days before he died in 2003.

Hope hosted the [Academy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Awards "Academy Awards") ceremony a record 19 times. He also appeared in many stage productions and television roles and wrote 14 books. The song "[Thanks for the Memory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thanks_for_the_Memory "Thanks for the Memory")" was his signature tune. He was praised for his comedic timing, specializing in one-liners and rapid-fire delivery of jokes that were often self-deprecating. Between 1941 and 1991, he made 57 tours for the [United Service Organizations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Service_Organizations "United Service Organizations") (USO), entertaining military personnel around the world. In 1997, Congress passed a bill that made him an honorary veteran of the Armed Forces.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-Library_of_Congress-1)

Hope was born in the [Eltham](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eltham "Eltham") district of southeast London. He arrived in the United States with his family at the age of four, and grew up near [Cleveland, Ohio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cleveland,_Ohio "Cleveland, Ohio"). He became a boxer in the late 1910s, but moved into show business in the early 1920s, initially as a comedian and dancer on the vaudeville circuit before acting on [Broadway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Broadway_theatre "Broadway theatre"). He began appearing on radio and in films in his 30s, starting in 1934.

## Early years

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bob_Hope&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early years")]

Leslie Townes Hope was born on May 29, 1903, in [Eltham](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eltham "Eltham"), [County of London](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/County_of_London "County of London")[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-ReferenceA-2) (now part of the [Royal Borough of Greenwich](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Borough_of_Greenwich "Royal Borough of Greenwich")), in a terraced house at 44 Craigton Road in [Well Hall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Well_Hall "Well Hall"),[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-BobBirthPlace-3)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-BobBirthPlace2-4) where there is now a British Film Institute 'Centenary of British Cinema' commemorative plaque in his memory.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-BobBirthPlace3-5) He was the fifth of seven sons of William Henry Hope, a stonemason from [Weston-super-Mare](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weston-super-Mare "Weston-super-Mare"), Somerset, and Welsh mother Avis (née Townes), a light opera singer from [Barry, Vale of Glamorgan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barry,_Vale_of_Glamorgan "Barry, Vale of Glamorgan"),[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-6) who later worked as a cleaner. William and Avis married in April 1891 and lived at 12 Greenwood Street in Barry before moving to [Whitehall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whitehall,_Bristol "Whitehall, Bristol"), Bristol, and then to [St George](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St_George,_Bristol "St George, Bristol"), Bristol. The family emigrated to the United States aboard the [SS _Philadelphia_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SS_Philadelphia_(1888) "SS Philadelphia (1888)"), passing through [Ellis Island](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellis_Island "Ellis Island"), New York on March 30, 1908, before moving on to Cleveland.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEMoreno200888-7)

From age 12, Hope earned pocket money by singing, dancing, and performing comedy on the street.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens20024-8) He entered numerous dancing and amateur talent contests as Lester Hope, and won a prize in 1915 for his impersonation of [Charlie Chaplin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Chaplin "Charlie Chaplin").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-loc.gov_Early_Life-9) For a time, he attended the [Boys' Industrial School](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boys'_Industrial_School_(Ohio)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Boys' Industrial School (Ohio) (page does not exist)") in [Lancaster, Ohio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lancaster,_Ohio "Lancaster, Ohio"), and as an adult donated sizable sums of money to the institution.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-ohiohistorycentral-10) He had a brief career as a boxer in 1919, fighting under the name Packy East. He had three wins and one loss, and he participated in a few staged charity bouts later in life.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-Boxing-Scoop.com-11) In December 1920, 17-year-old Hope and his brothers became [US citizens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/US_citizens "US citizens") when their British parents became [naturalised Americans](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_nationality_law "United States nationality law").[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-12) He legally changed his name from Leslie to Lester.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-Congress-13) Bob attended Fairmount Junior High and then East High in Cleveland but left before graduating. [[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-14)

In 1921, while working as a [lineman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lineman_(technician) "Lineman (technician)") for a power company, Hope was assisting his brother Jim in clearing trees when a tree fell, striking his face; his injuries required reconstructive surgery, which contributed to his later distinctive appearance.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-15) In his teens, he worked as a butcher's assistant, then briefly at Cleveland's [Chandler Motor Car Company](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandler_Motor_Car "Chandler Motor Car") in his early 20s.

[![Image 6](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3c/Bob_Hope_George_Byrne.jpg/330px-Bob_Hope_George_Byrne.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Bob_Hope_George_Byrne.jpg)

Byrne & Hope inscribed photo for the [Hilton Twins](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hilton_Twins "Hilton Twins")

Hope and his girlfriend later signed up for dancing lessons, encouraged after they performed in a three-day engagement at a club. Hope then formed a partnership with Lloyd Durbin, a friend from the dancing school.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk199819%E2%80%9323-16) Silent film comedian [Fatty Arbuckle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fatty_Arbuckle "Fatty Arbuckle") saw them perform in 1925 and found them work with a touring troupe called Hurley's Jolly Follies. Within a year, Hope had formed an act called the "Dancemedians" with George Byrne and the [Hilton Sisters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hilton_twins "Hilton twins"), conjoined twins who performed a tap-dancing routine on the vaudeville circuit. Hope and Byrne also had an act as [Siamese twins](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siamese_twins "Siamese twins"); they sang and danced while wearing blackface until friends advised Hope that he was funnier by himself.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFaith2003402%E2%80%93403-17)

In 1929, Hope informally changed his first name to "Bob". In one version of the story, he named himself after racecar driver [Bob Burman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Burman "Bob Burman").[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk199844-18) In another, he said that he chose the name because he wanted a name with a "friendly 'Hiya, fellas!' sound" to it.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens200215%E2%80%9316-19) In a 1942 legal document, his legal name appears as Lester Townes Hope.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-20) After five years on the vaudeville circuit, Hope was "surprised and humbled" when he failed a 1930 screen test for the [RKO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RKO "RKO")-[Pathé](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Path%C3%A9 "Pathé") short-subject studio at [Culver City, California](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Culver_City,_California "Culver City, California").[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk199857%E2%80%9358-21)

## Career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bob_Hope&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]

### 1927–1937: Early theatre and film roles

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bob_Hope&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: 1927–1937: Early theatre and film roles")]

[![Image 7](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/17/Bob_Hope.jpg/250px-Bob_Hope.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Bob_Hope.jpg)

Bob Hope

In the early days, Hope's career included appearances on stage in vaudeville shows and Broadway productions.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-PBS-22) Hope's first Broadway appearances, in 1927's _The Sidewalks of New York_ and 1928's _Ups-a-Daisy_, were minor walk-on parts.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFaith2003403-23) He returned to Broadway in 1933 to star as Huckleberry Haines in the [Jerome Kern](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerome_Kern "Jerome Kern") and [Dorothy Fields](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dorothy_Fields "Dorothy Fields") musical _[Roberta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roberta\_(musical) "Roberta (musical)")_.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk199871-24) Stints in the musicals _[Say When](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Say\_When\_(musical) "Say When (musical)")_, the 1936 [Ziegfeld Follies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ziegfeld_Follies "Ziegfeld Follies") with [Fanny Brice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fanny_Brice "Fanny Brice"), and _[Red, Hot and Blue](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red,\_Hot\_and\_Blue "Red, Hot and Blue")_ with [Ethel Merman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ethel_Merman "Ethel Merman") and [Jimmy Durante](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Durante "Jimmy Durante") followed.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk199873%E2%80%9375-25)

He began performing on the radio in 1934 mostly with [NBC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NBC "NBC") radio, and switched to television when that medium became popular in the 1950s. He started hosting regular TV specials in 1954,[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998229-26) and hosted the [Academy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Awards "Academy Awards") 19 times from 1939 through 1977.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-27) Overlapping with this was his movie career, spanning 1934 to 1972, and his [USO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USO "USO") tours, which he conducted from 1941 to 1991.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998318%E2%80%93320-28)[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens2002181%E2%80%93182-29)

Hope signed a contract with [Educational Pictures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Educational_Pictures "Educational Pictures") of New York for six short comedies. The first was a comedy, _[Going Spanish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Going\_Spanish "Going Spanish")_ (1934). He was not happy with it, and told newspaper columnist [Walter Winchell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Walter_Winchell "Walter Winchell"), "When they catch [bank robber] [Dillinger](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dillinger "Dillinger"), they're going to make him sit through it twice."[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEMaltin197225-30) Educational Pictures took umbrage at the remark and canceled Hope's contract after only the one film. He soon signed with the [Vitaphone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vitaphone "Vitaphone") short-subject studio in [Brooklyn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brooklyn "Brooklyn"), New York, making musical and comedy shorts during the day and performing in Broadway shows in the evenings.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998105,_107-31)

### 1938–1949: Hollywood contract and stardom

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bob_Hope&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: 1938–1949: Hollywood contract and stardom")]

[![Image 8](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b1/Bob_Hope_in_The_Ghost_Breakers_trailer.JPG/250px-Bob_Hope_in_The_Ghost_Breakers_trailer.JPG?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Bob_Hope_in_The_Ghost_Breakers_trailer.JPG)

Bob Hope in _[The Ghost Breakers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Ghost\_Breakers "The Ghost Breakers")_ trailer (1940)

Hope moved to [Hollywood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollywood,_Los_Angeles "Hollywood, Los Angeles") when [Paramount Pictures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramount_Pictures "Paramount Pictures") signed him for the 1938 film _[The Big Broadcast of 1938](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Big\_Broadcast\_of\_1938 "The Big Broadcast of 1938")_, also starring [W. C. Fields](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/W._C._Fields "W. C. Fields"). The song "[Thanks for the Memory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thanks_for_the_Memory "Thanks for the Memory")", which later became his trademark, was introduced in the film as a duet with [Shirley Ross](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shirley_Ross "Shirley Ross"), accompanied by [Shep Fields](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shep_Fields "Shep Fields") and his orchestra.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998110,_113-32) The sentimental, fluid nature of the music allowed Hope's writers—he depended heavily upon joke writers throughout his career[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTELahr1998-33)—to later create variations of the song to fit specific circumstances, such as bidding farewell to troops while on tour or mentioning the names of towns in which he was performing.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens2002133-34)

[![Image 9](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d8/Bob_Hope_and_Bing_Crosby_in_Road_to_Bali.jpg/250px-Bob_Hope_and_Bing_Crosby_in_Road_to_Bali.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Bob_Hope_and_Bing_Crosby_in_Road_to_Bali.jpg)

Hope and [Bing Crosby](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bing_Crosby "Bing Crosby") sing and dance during the number "Chicago Style" in _[Road to Bali](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Road\_to\_Bali "Road to Bali")_ (1952)

As a film star, Hope was best known for such comedies as _[My Favorite Brunette](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My\_Favorite\_Brunette "My Favorite Brunette")_ and the highly successful "[Road](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Road_to_... "Road to ...")" movies in which he starred with [Bing Crosby](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bing_Crosby "Bing Crosby") and [Dorothy Lamour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dorothy_Lamour "Dorothy Lamour"). The series consists of seven films made between 1940 and 1962: _[Road to Singapore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Road\_to\_Singapore "Road to Singapore")_ (1940), _[Road to Zanzibar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Road\_to\_Zanzibar "Road to Zanzibar")_ (1941), _[Road to Morocco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Road\_to\_Morocco "Road to Morocco")_ (1942), _[Road to Utopia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Road\_to\_Utopia "Road to Utopia")_ (1946), _[Road to Rio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Road\_to\_Rio "Road to Rio")_ (1947), _[Road to Bali](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Road\_to\_Bali "Road to Bali")_ (1952), and _[The Road to Hong Kong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Road\_to\_Hong\_Kong "The Road to Hong Kong")_ (1962). At the outset, Paramount executives were amazed at how relaxed and compatible Hope and Crosby were as a team. What the executives didn't know was that Hope and Crosby had already worked together (on the vaudeville stage in 1932), and that working so easily in the "Road" pictures was just an extension of their old stage act.

Hope had seen Lamour performing as a nightclub singer in New York,[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998112-35) and invited her to work on his [United Service Organizations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Service_Organizations "United Service Organizations") (USO) tours of military facilities. Lamour sometimes arrived for filming prepared with her lines, only to be baffled by completely rewritten scripts or ad-libbed dialogue between Hope and Crosby.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998128-36) Hope and Lamour were lifelong friends, and she remains the actress most associated with his film career although he made movies with dozens of [leading ladies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leading_lady "Leading lady"), including [Katharine Hepburn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katharine_Hepburn "Katharine Hepburn"), [Paulette Goddard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paulette_Goddard "Paulette Goddard"), [Hedy Lamarr](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hedy_Lamarr "Hedy Lamarr"), [Lucille Ball](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucille_Ball "Lucille Ball"), [Rosemary Clooney](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rosemary_Clooney "Rosemary Clooney"), [Jane Russell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jane_Russell "Jane Russell"), and [Elke Sommer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elke_Sommer "Elke Sommer").[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens2002174%E2%80%93180-37)

Hope and Crosby teamed not only for the "Road" pictures, but for many stage, radio, and television appearances and many brief movie appearances together over the decades[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998127-38) until Crosby died in 1977. Although the two invested together in oil leases and other business ventures, worked together frequently, and lived near each other, they rarely saw each other socially.[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998127,_137-39) After the release of _Road to Singapore_ (1940), Hope's screen career took off, and he had a long and successful run. After an 11-year hiatus from the "Road" genre, he and Crosby reteamed for _The Road to Hong Kong_ (1962), starring the 28-year-old [Joan Collins](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joan_Collins "Joan Collins") in place of Lamour, whom Crosby thought was too old for the part.[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998265-40) They had planned one more movie together in 1977, _The Road to the Fountain of Youth_, but filming was postponed when Crosby was injured in a fall, and the production was canceled when he suddenly died of heart failure that October.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998287-41)

Hope starred in 54 theatrical features between 1938 and 1972,[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens200241-42) as well as cameos and short films. Most of his later movies failed to match the success of his 1940s efforts. He was disappointed with his appearance in _[Cancel My Reservation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cancel\_My\_Reservation "Cancel My Reservation")_ (1972), his last starring film; critics and filmgoers panned the movie.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk1998285%E2%80%93286-43) Though his career as a film star effectively ended in 1972, he did make a few cameo film appearances into the 1980s.

[![Image 10](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/b/bb/Colonnahope.jpg/250px-Colonnahope.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Colonnahope.jpg)

[Jerry Colonna](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerry_Colonna_(entertainer) "Jerry Colonna (entertainer)") and Hope, as caricatured by [Sam Berman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sam_Berman "Sam Berman") for NBC's 1947 promotional book

Hope's [career in broadcasting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope_television_appearances "Bob Hope television appearances") began on radio in 1934. His first regular series for [NBC Radio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NBC_Radio "NBC Radio") was the _Woodbury Soap Hour_ in 1937, on a 26-week contract. Serving as the master of ceremonies for these _Rippling Rhythm Revue_ radio broadcasts, Hope collaborated with the big band leader [Shep Fields](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shep_Fields "Shep Fields") during this period of transition from vaudeville to radio.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-44)[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-46) A year later, _[The Pepsodent Show Starring Bob Hope](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Pepsodent\_Show\_Starring\_Bob\_Hope "The Pepsodent Show Starring Bob Hope")_ began, and Hope signed a ten-year contract with the show's sponsor, [Lever Brothers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever_Brothers "Lever Brothers"). He hired eight writers and paid them out of his salary of $2,500 a week. The original staff included [Mel Shavelson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mel_Shavelson "Mel Shavelson"), [Norman Panama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norman_Panama "Norman Panama"), [Jack Rose](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_Rose_(screenwriter) "Jack Rose (screenwriter)"), [Sherwood Schwartz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherwood_Schwartz "Sherwood Schwartz"), and Schwartz's brother [Al](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al_Schwartz_(writer) "Al Schwartz (writer)"). The writing staff eventually grew to 15.[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTENachman1998144-47) The show became the top radio program in the country. Regulars on the series included [Jerry Colonna](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerry_Colonna_(entertainer) "Jerry Colonna (entertainer)") and [Barbara Jo Allen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barbara_Jo_Allen "Barbara Jo Allen") as spinster Vera Vague. Hope continued his lucrative career in radio into the 1950s, when radio's popularity began being overshadowed by the upstart television medium.[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens200230%E2%80%9332-48)[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEQuirk199892%E2%80%93103-49)

### 1950–1979: Television specials

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bob_Hope&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: 1950–1979: Television specials")]

Hope did many specials for the NBC television network in the following decades, beginning in April 1950. He was one of the first people to use [cue cards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cue_card "Cue card"). The shows often were sponsored by [Frigidaire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frigidaire "Frigidaire") (early 1950s), [General Motors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Motors "General Motors") (1955–61), [Chrysler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chrysler "Chrysler") (1963–73), and [Texaco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texaco "Texaco") (1975–85).[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens200247%E2%80%9348-50) Hope's Christmas specials were popular favorites and often featured a performance of "[Silver Bells](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silver_Bells "Silver Bells")"—from his 1951 film _[The Lemon Drop Kid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Lemon\_Drop\_Kid "The Lemon Drop Kid")_—done as a duet with an often much younger female guest star such as [Barbara Mandrell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barbara_Mandrell "Barbara Mandrell"), [Olivia Newton-John](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olivia_Newton-John "Olivia Newton-John"), [Barbara Eden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barbara_Eden "Barbara Eden"), and [Brooke Shields](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brooke_Shields "Brooke Shields"),[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens2002160-51) or with his wife Dolores, a former singer with whom he dueted on two specials.

On April 26, 1970, [CBS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CBS "CBS") released the [Raquel Welch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raquel_Welch "Raquel Welch") television special _[Raquel!](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raquel! "Raquel!")_; in it Hope appears as a guest.[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-52) Hope's 1970 Christmas special for NBC—filmed in [Vietnam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnam "Vietnam") in front of military audiences at the height of the war—is on the list of the [highest-rated broadcasts in US history](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most_watched_television_broadcasts_in_the_United_States#The_highest-rated_broadcasts_of_all_time "List of most watched television broadcasts in the United States"). It was seen by more than 60 percent of the US households watching television.[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGrudens200248-53) Likely the most unusual of his television specials was _Joys!_, a parody of murder mystery narratives, where the audience discovers at the end of the broadcast that Johnny Carson was the villain.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-54)[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-55)

Beginning in early 1950, Hope licensed rights to publish a [celebrity comic book](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Celebrity_comics "Celebrity comics") titled _[The Adventures of Bob Hope](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Adventures\_of\_Bob\_Hope "The Adventures of Bob Hope")_ to National Periodical Publications, alias [DC Comics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_Comics "DC Comics"). The comic, originally featuring publicity stills of Hope on the cover, was entirely made up of fictional stories, eventually including fictitious relatives, a high school taught by movie monsters, and a superhero called [Super-Hip](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super-Hip "Super-Hip").[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-RetFan25-56) It was published intermittently and continued publication through issue No. 109 in 1969. Writers included [Arnold Drake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arnold_Drake "Arnold Drake"), and illustrators included [Bob Oksner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Oksner "Bob Oksner") and (for the last four issues) [Neal Adams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neal_Adams "Neal Adams").[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-RetFan25-56) Hope reprised his role as Huck Haines in a 1958 production of _Roberta_ at [The Muny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Muny "The Muny") Theater in [Forest Park in](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forest_Park_(St._Louis,_Missouri) "Forest Park (St. Louis, Missouri)")[St. Louis, Missouri](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Louis,_Missouri "St. Louis, Missouri").[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-The_Muny_1958-57) Additionally, Hope rescued the [Eltham Little Theatre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Bob_Hope_Theatre "The Bob Hope Theatre") in England from closure by providing funds to buy the property. He continued his interest and support, and regularly visited the facility when in London. The theater was renamed in his honor in 1982.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hope#cite_note-bobhopetheatre_100th-58)
